sovereign_country.strategic_role: 拉美西语近岸软件研发外包与数字客服中心

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Global Employer of Record and Cross-Border Contractor Payroll

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Colombia (Republic of Colombia) - unitary national jurisdiction without sub-state tax distinctions
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (Continental European tradition; codified Commercial Code, Decreto 410 de 1971)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Colombia-United States Trade Promotion Agreement (FTA, in force 2012)
Pacific Alliance framework with Mexico, Chile and Peru
Colombia-Spain Double Taxation Agreement (DTA, in force 2008)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Ley 526 de 1999 (creation of UIAF and AML/CFT regulatory framework); Ley 1121 de 2006 (counter-terrorist financing); Código Penal (Ley 599 de 2000) arts. 323-326 (money laundering and financing of terrorism predicate offences); Ley 2010 de 2019 (UBO register mandate); Decreto 830 de 2021 (Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales - RUB; 5% ownership threshold; filing within one month after mercantile registration); Circular 004 de 2021 (UIAF rules on PEPs and beneficial ownership); SARLAFT internal risk-management standards applied by analogy for licensed staffing and payroll intermediaries; Decreto 1674 de 2016 (DIAN inspection and control powers).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation and Certificate of Good Standing of ultimate corporate shareholder (parent entity)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent companies registry in the parent company's country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille by the origin country designated authority; followed by certified Spanish translation by a Colombian sworn translator

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized Power of Attorney from all shareholders appointing the SAS legal representative and executing incorporation formalities
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in the shareholders' country of origin or Colombian Consulate for consular execution
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille for member states; otherwise Colombian Consular Legalization at the competent Colombian Embassy or Consulate

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified passport copies and UBO identification documents for all individual and indirect beneficial owners
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport-issuing authority or notary of the home country; for corporate shareholders, certified copy of registry extract
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille with notarized copy certification; Colombian consular certification where the origin state is not a Hague member

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Sworn UBO declaration and PEP status form (Declaración de Beneficiario Final) for the RUB registry and DIAN
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Colombian notary public in the domicile city of the SAS
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Domestic notarization only; no apostille required as the document is filed electronically to the DIAN-managed RUB

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory negative-list screening of every shareholder, UBO, director, legal representative and ultimate beneficial owner against: (i) OFAC Specially Designated Nationals (SDN) and embargoed lists; (ii) UN Security Council consolidated sanctions; (iii) EU consolidated financial sanctions; (iv) Colombian UIAF and Consejo Nacional de Estupefacientes terrorist-financing lists; and (v) national PEP registries maintained by the Procuraduría, Contraloría and UIAF. Enhanced due diligence and senior-management approval required for any PEP, foreign PEP or sanctioned nexus. Suspicious operation reports must be submitted to UIAF within the mandatory reporting schedule applicable to regulated payroll and staff-intermediation entities.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: RUES - Registro Único Empresarial y Social (www.rues.org.co), operated through the local Cámara de Comercio (for a Bogotá domicile, the Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá portal, www.ccb.org.co)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Corporate names must be expressed in Spanish using the Spanish alphabet; foreign-language or cross-border brand names must be transliterated phonetically into Spanish; numerals and established abbreviations are permitted only in the transliterated form.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Any term falsely implying state sponsorship, regulated financial activity, public utility concession or misleading similarity with an existing registered company
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: A homonymy certificate is valid for 30 days and is not automatically extendable; a new request with re-payment of the tariff is required after expiry. Upon rejection: (i) submit a corrected name application; (ii) if denied, file a written derecho de petición with the relevant Cámara de Comercio within 10 business days, stating the legal basis and requesting reconsideration; (iii) on second denial, file an administrative appeal with the Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio exercising registry oversight; (iv) as final remedy, pursue annulment proceedings before the Jurisdicción Contencioso Administrativa (Council of State).

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permissible as the sole registered office for an EOR/staffing agency holding a Ministry of Labor authorization and UIAF-regulated status: a physical establishment with payroll records and local personnel is required. A monitored office or co-working address may be used only as a supplementary administrative address and not as the domicile disclosed to the Cámara de Comercio, DIAN and Ministry of Labor.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Moderate-to-high (approximately 40% probability within the first operating year); the Ministry of Labor conducts unannounced verification visits for licensed temporary-employment and payroll intermediaries, and UIAF/DIAN may perform on-site AML/CFT compliance inspections.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Homonymy certificate and name clearance (Certificado de Homonimia) in RUES
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Cámara de Comercio (e.g., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff fixed by Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio; approximately COP 55,000

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarial fees for execution of the incorporation instrument (deed or registered private document) and UBO sworn declaration
Mercantile registration of the SAS and filing of bye-laws (matrícula mercantil)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff of 0.7% of subscribed capital with fixed minimum; approximately COP 350,000 minimum

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Tax registration (RUT - Registro Único Tributario) at DIAN
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: DIAN - Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Initial UBO register (RUB) filing in the DIAN electronic system
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Free statutory filing; required within one month after mercantile registration

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Hague Apostille of three corporate documents of the foreign parent (certificate of incorporation, good standing, passport copies)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Designated apostille authority of the document's country of origin
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Per-document government fee; approximately USD 15 per document

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certified Spanish translation of three foreign corporate documents by a Colombian sworn translator
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Certified translator (registered with the Colombian Ministry of Foreign Affairs)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing professional tariff; approximately USD 20 per document

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Pre-incorporation legal due diligence, corporate name clearance and draft bye-laws review
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for cross-border SAS incorporation with UBO piercing

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Electronic signature and digital certificate for RUES and DIAN electronic filings
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Cámara de Comercio / certified IT provider
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market rate for digital certificate issuance

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley 1258 de 2008 (Colombian Simplified Stock Company / S.A.S. Act), arts. 2, 5, 17, 21 and 40; Código de Comercio, arts. 98, 110, 373 and 374; Decreto Único Reglamentario 1074 de 2015, as amended.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Cámara de Comercio del domicilio social; filing processed through RUES (Registro Único Empresarial y Social) under the public oversight of the Superintendencia de Sociedades.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Documento Privado de Constitución (private incorporation instrument) submitted for registration; public deed if selected by incorporators or required for certain in-kind contributions.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum capital for S.A.S. entities; capital may be subscribed and paid within a maximum of two years. No government escrow deposit is required for cash contributions; in-kind contributions must be described and appraised in the incorporation document.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED by the founding shareholders as the first corporate governance act: (1) The private incorporation instrument of the S.A.S. is approved, and the employer-of-record and contractor payroll corporate purpose is adopted. (2) The subscribed share capital is accepted; shareholders ratify their payment obligations under the bylaws. (3) The registered office is fixed at the address stated in the deed within Colombia. (4) The sole legal representative and alternates are appointed with full powers to open bank accounts and execute payroll and employment contracts. (5) The legal representative is directed to complete incorporation, NIT, and labor licensing filings. This resolution is effective immediately and recorded.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio del domicilio social via the RUES online window
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Request a name-availability search from the Chamber of Commerce through its electronic platform. Obtain the certificate of homonymy confirming that the proposed S.A.S. name is not identical or confusingly similar to an existing registered company; reserve the name for the statutory reservation period before incorporation.
required_dossiers: proposed corporate name in Spanish
copy of the identification document or passport of each shareholder
contact details of the subscribing parties and legal representative
power of attorney if one incorporator files on behalf of others
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is not available, promptly submit a corrective request with one or more alternative names and repeat the homonymy search at no additional substantive review; if the Chamber issues a conflicting objection, file a written reconsideration before the same Chamber window.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Execution of the S.A.S. Private Incorporation Instrument
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Founding shareholders, with optional notarization before a Colombian Notary or use of certified electronic signatures
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the private incorporation instrument containing the corporate name, registered office address, precise corporate purpose, duration, subscribed and paid capital, number and classes of shares, payment terms, administration, legal representation, fiscal year, audit rules, and statutory or optional dispute resolution provisions. Execute the instrument before all shareholders or attorneys; notarize signature certificates where required or when contributions consist of real property or other in-kind assets requiring public deed formality.
required_dossiers: draft S.A.S. estatutos/bylaws
name reservation certificate
valid passport or national ID of each shareholder
tax identification documents of shareholders
power of attorney and passport of the appointed legal representative if acting by proxy
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary or Chamber legal review finds a contractual defect, the shareholders execute a corrective private instrument or supplementary resolution amending the relevant clause and re-execute the affected signature pages.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Commercial Registration in the RUES before the Cámara de Comercio
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio with territorial jurisdiction over the registered office; digital filing through the RUES portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the executed corporate instrument and supporting documents to the Cámara de Comercio, pay the applicable mercantile registration fees and stamp taxes, and request inscription in the Commercial Register. After verification and payment, obtain the Certificate of Existence and Legal Representation (Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal), which is the proof of incorporation for third parties.
required_dossiers: executed private incorporation instrument or public deed
certificate of name reservation
shareholder identification documents
notarial authentication if required
proof of payment of registration tariff and stamp fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the submission is objected to, correct the formal defects indicated in the Chamber's observation sheet within the applicable legal timeframe and resubmit. If registration is withheld or denied, the interested party may request reconsideration before the Chamber or seek administrative review before the Superintendencia de Sociedades.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax Registration and Issuance of NIT/RUT before the DIAN
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales) – RUT module and electronic signature portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the RUT application with the certificate of incorporation, select the national and local tax obligations for the S.A.S., obtain the NIT, and register the electronic invoicing system requirements. The legal representative must update the RUT after any change of address, activity, or legal status, and obtain the electronic signature for digital filings and e-invoicing.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal
valid identification document of the legal representative
proof of principal place of business address
corporate email and contact telephone number
RUT pre-registration form or initial NIT request
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If DIAN assigns an incorrect tax-return obligation or rejects the application, present a corrective RUT update through the 'Actualización RUT' online process or attend the corresponding DIAN office; unresolved discrepancies may be addressed through the administrative channels set out in the Estatuto Tributario.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Governance Books, Share Registry, and Officer Ratification
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: S.A.S. shareholders' meeting and legal representative, with book registration by the Cámara de Comercio and supervisory oversight by the Superintendencia de Sociedades
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Request the Cámara de Comercio to register and stamp the corporate books (shareholder registry, shareholders' meeting minute book, and any board or administrator minute book) before initial use. Record the approved first resolution, capital subscription, share issuance, officer appointments, and registered office adoption. Keep an up-to-date shareholder registry reflecting all transfers and encumbrances, and adopt internal controls for conflicts of interest, financial reporting, and fiscal auditor review where mandatory.
required_dossiers: registry application and stamped-book request form
copy of the Certificate of Existence and Legal Representation
share subscription and payment schedule
duly signed officer acceptance forms
initial corporate minute book and shareholder registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: In case of a book-stamping refusal or governance-book defect, correct the pagination, chronology, or authorization forms and resubmit to the same Chamber; for governance omissions, pass a ratifying shareholder resolution and record it in the minutes.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministerio del Trabajo – Unidad Administrativa Especial del Servicio Público de Empleo (UAESPE); complementary commercial and corporate oversight by Superintendencia de Sociedades and Cámara de Comercio
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Registro de Prestador de Servicios de Empleo / Employer-of-Record Operational Authorization under Ley 1636 de 2013 and Decreto 722 de 2013, as amended

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministerio de Ambiente y Desarrollo Sostenible / Autoridad Nacional de Licencias Ambientales (ANLA), with local municipal environmental offices for office-operation permits
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt from a full EIA for a non-industrial administrative and payroll office under Decreto 1076 de 2015; only simple environmental registration is applicable if required by the local environmental authority for solid-waste generation.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No industrial wastewater or VOC point-source emissions are generated; office sanitary discharges shall connect to the municipal sewer in accordance with local utility rules, and waste equipment must be transferred to authorized e-waste handlers under Ley 1672 de 2013.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire-safety technical concept (concepto técnico de bomberos) for the physical office; favorable land-use certificate (uso de suelo) issued by the municipal planning office; structural-load and occupation-capacity certification from a licensed architect or engineer; and compliance with the mandatory workplace health and safety system (SG-SST) under Resolución 0312 de 2019.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) – Colombian national tax and customs authority; official portal www.dian.gov.co; electronic registration and filing platform MUISCA (Modelo Único de Ingresos, Servicio y Control Automatizado) at muisca.dian.gov.co.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: 1) Incorporate the S.A.S. before a notary and register with the local Cámara de Comercio; 2) upon registration, DIAN automatically assigns the NIT (Número de Identificación Tributaria, 9-digit code plus verification digit), which is reflected on the RUT (Registro Único Tributario); 3) access MUISCA with the NIT and the mandatory digital signature (Firma Electrónica DIAN) to update economic activity ISIC 7810, VAT status as Responsable de IVA – Régimen Común, and withholding-agent (Agente de Retención) status; 4) for a foreign non-resident company without a local entity, obtain an NIT by filing the RUT enrolment through MUISCA, appointing a Colombian attorney-in-fact, and registering the foreign company's permanent-establishment status for any Colombian-source services; 5) request the electronic invoicing authorization (Habilitación de Facturación Electrónica) in the same MUISCA session before the first taxable transaction.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation – the Colombian S.A.S. is a resident tax entity taxed at the entity level on worldwide income under the Impuesto de Renta (35% headline rate for tax year 2025); pass-through treatment is not available. Colombian-source income remains the territorial nexus for non-resident shareholders receiving dividends, which are subject to a 10% dividend withholding tax at the shareholder level.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No U.S.-style check-the-box election exists under Colombian law. Available statutory elections: (i) optional accession to the Régimen Simple de Tributación (SIMPLE) under E.T. Articles 905 et seq., replacing income tax, VAT and local industry/commerce tax with a single turnover-based tax at rates of 1.8%–14.5%, available only if prior-year gross income does not exceed 100,000 UVT (approximately COP 4.98 billion in 2025) and other eligibility conditions are met; (ii) the de minimis No Responsable de IVA status for natural persons and small goods vendors with gross income not exceeding 3,500 UVT (approximately COP 174.3 million in 2025), which is unavailable to a service company such as an EOR staffing platform; (iii) voluntary registration as a withholding agent for domestic and cross-border payments; (iv) election of the simplified formula for the 10% advance instalment of corporate income tax for taxpayers with prior-year net revenue not exceeding certain UVT limits.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: IVA – Impuesto sobre las Ventas (Colombian Value Added Tax)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No monetary exemption threshold: any enterprise providing taxable services in Colombia must register in the RUT and obtain VAT status before commencing activities, regardless of turnover. De minimis thresholds apply only to goods-only merchants (income not exceeding 3,500 UVT, approximately COP 174.3 million in 2025), which is unavailable to a staffing/EOR services taxpayer; the SIMPLE regime turnover ceiling is 100,000 UVT (approximately COP 4.98 billion in 2025).
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory electronic invoicing through DIAN's MUISCA platform: all VAT-responsible taxpayers must issue the Factura Electrónica de Venta (FEV) in XML under UBL 2.1, signed with the DIAN digital certificate and transmitted via DIAN-authorised Proveedores Tecnológicos (API/SOAP web services, REST/JSON integration). Each invoice must contain the unique CUFE/CUDE code and a QR code. DIAN assigns each taxpayer an emission profile of validación previa (real-time fiscal clearance: the invoice is validated against MUISCA before delivery to the buyer) or validación posterior (clearance within a set period). Export transactions require the Factura Electrónica de Exportación with a designated export type code, recorded alongside the relevant foreign-trade declarations. No physical fiscal stamp is affixed; the legal digital seal is the CUFE/CUDE code accompanied by DIAN's electronic acceptance event.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Goods: a legal export qualifies for the 0% excluded VAT rate when the goods leave Colombian customs territory under a DEX export declaration filed by the exporter or an authorised customs agent and the sale is made to a foreign counterparty with shipment abroad. Services: a service qualifies as an export of services under E.T. Article 481 when (i) the recipient is a non-resident entity with no domicile or residence in Colombia, (ii) the service is used exclusively outside Colombia, the benefit, use or appreciation occurring entirely abroad, and (iii) the payment is received in freely convertible foreign currency and channelled through Colombian foreign-exchange intermediary rules; the exporter must issue the electronic export invoice and hold RUT status with export activities. Practical caveat for ISIC 7810 EOR/staffing services: DIAN restricts zero-rating where the workforce or the operative benefit of payroll, contractor management or back-office services occurs in Colombia, so the S.A.S. must document that the contractual benefit is consumed abroad and should obtain a protective advance ruling or consult DIAN before applying 0% IVA.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (DEX – Declaración de Exportación) for tangible goods, complemented by the electronic export invoice (Factura Electrónica de Exportación) with CUFE code for services
Bill of Lading (oceanic) or Airway Bill (air) evidencing exit of goods from Colombian customs territory with the consignee located outside Colombia

Inward Remittance Certificate / Declaración de Cambio por Exportación de Servicios issued by an authorised Colombian foreign-exchange intermediary, evidencing legal repatriation of the export proceeds in freely convertible currency
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DIAN may retroactively disallow the 0% export treatment and assess the full 19% IVA on the gross invoice, plus default interest (intereses moratorios) from the original due date of the VAT return. False or inexact export claims trigger the 100% to 200% sanción por inexactitud under E.T. Articles 648 and 649 on the resulting VAT or income-tax differences, and improper refund or offset claims may incur the additional sanction for unjustified refunds under E.T. Article 670. Fraudulent customs or exchange declarations can constitute criminal tax fraud under Código Penal Article 402 and Law 2277 of 2022, carrying imprisonment and fines equal to the evaded tax; repeat offences and sham invoicing arrangements may additionally lead to DIAN collection proceedings, precautionary seizure of assets, loss of the exporter's special registration, and exclusion from government procurement registers.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de la República de Colombia (Central Bank of Colombia), acting jointly with the Ministerio de Hacienda y Crédito Público and the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia, is the foreign-exchange control authority under Law 9 of 1991, Resolution Externa No. 8 of 2000, and Decree 1068 of 2015; the DIAN administers export declarations and customs documentation.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Colombian peso (COP) is freely convertible at a unified floating market rate. Current-account transactions, including service exports and employment-related cross-border payments, are settled without quantitative limits but must be routed exclusively through authorized FX intermediaries and declared on the electronic Declaración de Cambio (Formulario No. 7). Capital-account inflows through the foreign direct investment (FDI) route are open to non-residents and must be registered with the Banco de la República to secure future capital and profit remittance rights; profit remittances are permitted once Colombian taxes are settled, subject to the statutory dividend withholding rate (generally 10% for non-resident shareholders, with possible treaty relief). No compulsory surrender to the central bank and no exchange-profit tax apply, but all operations require formal FX-channeling documentation and a documented source of funds.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Colombia operates a channeling (canalización) regime rather than a conversion or surrender quota: 100% of foreign-currency export proceeds from goods and services must be repatriated and channeled through an authorized FX intermediary, or credited to an approved foreign-currency or compensation account, within the term endorsed on the export declaration or the service contract, generally up to six months after shipment or the due settlement date for services. There is no mandatory conversion ratio; the exporting S.A.S. may retain USD/EUR in a local foreign-currency account or sell the proceeds to the interbank market at the prevailing market rate. Evidence is the bank-encoded Declaración de Cambio, and failure to repatriate or channel within the applicable timeline exposes the company to exchange-control penalties under Law 9 of 1991 and Resolution Externa No. 8 of 2000.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account (Cuenta Corriente Empresarial) plus foreign-currency USD receivable account
Operational Account for payroll clearing and social security disbursements
Operational Account and FX-forward settlement account
Capital Escrow Account and Operational Account for cross-border clearing

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Medium, as a restricted gateway only. Foreign digital EMIs (e.g., Wise, Airwallex, Payoneer) are not locally chartered financial institutions and cannot obtain authorization under the Colombian Statutory Financial System to operate as banks or FX intermediaries; they may be used for cross-border collection, contractor payouts, and international card issuance, but all domestic COP payroll, social security, and tax obligations must be settled through a Colombian regulated financial institution. Using an offshore EMI as the principal treasury ledger raises SARLAFT concerns and FX-channeling non-compliance risk unless funds are cascaded into a licensed onshore bank account with proper Declaración de Cambio support.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: The Colombian legal representative and, where requested, a designated beneficial-owner director must attend an in-person KYC interview at a Tier-1 bank branch; most institutions require the local representative to be physically present, while foreign non-resident directors may be excused only if the board resolution is apostilled, the local attorney-in-fact appears, and the ultimate beneficial owner (UBO) declaration is filed. Bancolombia and BBVA Colombia permit hybrid remote onboarding for non-resident shareholders under SARLAFT protocols, whereas Banco Davivienda and Itaú Corpbanca generally retain stricter physical-attendance policies for the S.A.S. statutory representative.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident beneficial owners controlling the Colombian S.A.S. with no local operating history
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Apostilled board resolutions, certificado de existencia y representación legal, RUT certificate, complete UBO and beneficial-ownership filing under DIAN Resolution 164 of 2020, passports of all shareholders, sworn statement of source of funds, and the S.A.S. by-laws translated into Spanish.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-volume, low-value salary disbursements to a large roster of individual employees triggering suspicious structured-transaction detection
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified payroll register with national ID numbers, Spanish-language employment or contractor services agreements, monthly PILA social-security contribution receipts, and reconciliation reports matching inbound client funds to the payroll disbursement cycle.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Pass-through movement pattern where inbound USD wires are immediately followed by same-day COP payroll outbound credits
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Underlying global EOR client service agreements and invoices, FX declarations (Formulario No. 7) evidencing the service-export and channeling of receivables, a payroll clearing schedule, and a written treasury policy describing the funding cascade.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Operation of global Employer of Record services in Colombia without a clearly recognized local labor-licensing legal basis
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Ministry of Labor authorization or registration where the activity qualifies as temporary services employment under Decree 4369 of 2006, a Colombian labor-counsel legal opinion confirming the S.A.S. is the direct employer for EOR engagements, and evidence of compliance with Colombian employment and social-security laws.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Non-resident shareholders wire equity contributions via SWIFT MT103 or MT202 to the S.A.S. operational account at an authorized Colombian bank, identifying the remittance as FDI share capital with the applicable foreign-investment concept code under Annex 1 of Circular Reglamentaria DCIN-83, and the receiving bank records the operation in the Declaración de Cambio and in the Banco de la República international-investment registry; the bank verifies the RUT, certificate of incorporation, and shareholder resolution before crediting, and the COP conversion is executed at the market rate only if needed for working capital.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Domestic payroll and social-security payments are cleared through ACH Colombia (débito directo) or the CENIT real-time settlement system directly from the operational account, with pension, health, and parafiscal contributions routed through the official PILA collection portal; cross-border contractor net-pay is executed by SWIFT MT103 to foreign beneficiary banks or to a permitted fintech gateway, while larger vendor or guarantee payments may be structured as commercial documentary letters of credit or reimbursements under MT103/MT202 for goods-related settlements.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: USD/COP deliverable forwards executed through authorized Colombian FX intermediaries on the onshore forward market
USD/COP non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) where physical COP settlement is operationally impracticable for cross-border hedge book management
USD/COP foreign-exchange swaps with an onshore authorized intermediary for short-term liquidity mismatches between USD receipts and COP payroll obligations
Cross-currency swaps (USD/EUR versus COP) to align Euro-denominated EOR client billing with local peso costs
Currency options on the USD/COP pair purchased through a supervised commercial bank or licensed FX intermediary

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Commercial Registration Renewal (Renovación de la Matrícula Mercantil)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio of the local domicile; data migrated to RUES (Registro Único Empresarial)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually between 1 January and 31 March; no extensions
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late renewal after 31 March triggers a 50% surcharge on the renewal fee plus moratory interest; renewal is suspended, and failure to renew for two consecutive years causes administrative cancellation (strike-off) of the mercantile registration.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual shareholders' meeting for approval of financial statements (Estados Financieros) and management report; minutes recorded in corporate books
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Shareholders' assembly (internal governance); the approved statements are deposited with the Chamber of Commerce
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 3 months after fiscal year-end (31 March for a calendar-year entity); the approved statements must be filed with the Chamber of Commerce within 30 days of approval
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Persistent omission enables the Superintendencia de Sociedades to impose an administrative fine of up to 50 SMMLV and to compel the meeting; unapproved or unfiled statements constitute a compliance breach under Ley 222/1995.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate income tax return (Form 210 – Declaración de Renta y Complementario)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DIAN – Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Between mid-April and mid-June of the following tax year according to the last two digits of the NIT, per the annual DIAN resolution
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing sanction under ET Art. 641: 1% of tax payable per month or fraction of delay, capped at 100% of the tax; if no tax is due, 1% of gross income capped at 1,000 UVT with a 10-UVT minimum; moratory interest accrues until payment.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual final beneficial owner declaration (Declaración de Beneficiarios Finales – Form 350)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DIAN – Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (Obliged-Subject platform)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually in April–May by a two-digit NIT schedule fixed by DIAN resolution; reflects shareholding as of 31 December of the preceding year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Untimely, false, or omitted declarations are subject to fines under ET Art. 651 of up to 10,000 UVT per filing; the company's electronic invoicing and tax compliance certificates may be blocked until the declaration is accepted.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Transfer pricing documentary return (Form 120) where the EOR platform exceeds applicable thresholds
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DIAN – Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Same window as the corporate income tax return (Form 210) according to the NIT schedule
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Delayed or omitted filing triggers the ET Art. 641 extemporaneity sanction and, when mandatory, an additional fine of up to 10,000 UVT under ET Art. 651; no strike-off effect.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Independent auditor (Revisor Fiscal) is mandatory for an S.A.S. when total assets on 31 December of the prior year exceed 5,000 UVT (approx. COP 235 million for 2024) or gross income for that year exceeds 3,000 UVT (approx. COP 141 million), per Ley 1258/2008 art. 8 and Decree 1992/2019; an EOR staffing license may impose audit requirements at lower thresholds.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Colombian accounting framework under Ley 1314/2009: full IFRS (NIIF) for Group 1 entities; IFRS for SMEs (NIIF para las PYMES) for a typical S.A.S.; financial statements denominated in COP with comparative prior-year disclosures.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Every share transfer or ownership change during the fiscal year must be recorded in the share register and formally approved before the annual UBO declaration is filed with DIAN. Any individual holding, directly or indirectly, more than 5% of capital or voting rights, or exercising de facto control, must be reported as final beneficiary as of 31 December. Discrepancies between the shareholders' book and the DIAN UBO platform are treated as inaccurate declarations. Statutory corporate books must be registered and sealed by the Chamber of Commerce before first use.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Shareholders (Libro de Registro de Accionistas)
Register of Shareholders' Assembly Minutes (Libro de Actas de Asamblea de Accionistas)
Register of Board of Directors' Minutes, where a board exists (Libro de Actas de Junta Directiva)
Corporate resolutions and non-waivable shareholder consent records (Libro de Decisiones de los Accionistas)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 250–600 per year for registered corporate domicile, virtual office, and local representative/agent services in Colombia
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 1,000–3,500 per year for an independent Revisor Fiscal engagement by a Colombian certified public accountant for an operating EOR platform
